canonical_statement: Individual identity and future state are determined by the accumulation of wisdom and the initiation of causal actions.

attributions.surface_quote: All that man is is because of his wisdom. All that he shall be is the result of his cause.

canonical_statement: Spiritual growth requires intentional effort to ascend to a higher plane of existence characterized by universal Light.

attributions.surface_quote: Only by effort shall ye grow upward to the plane where Light is the All of the All.

canonical_statement: The individual possesses the capacity to transcend environmental conditioning by mastering the causes of their own life.

attributions.surface_quote: Be ye the master of all that surrounds thee. Never be mastered by the effects of thy life.

canonical_statement: The essential nature of the soul is identical to the Greater Light when liberated from lower-dimensional constraints.

attributions.surface_quote: Know that thou art the Greater Light, perfect in thine own sphere, when thou art free.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is fundamentally unified with the totality of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: man in his movement through space-time shall ever be One with the All.

canonical_statement: The future is not predetermined but is a fluid outcome of current causal actions.

attributions.surface_quote: the future is not fixed or stable but varies as cause brings forth an effect.

canonical_statement: The evolution of the soul is a teleological progression toward ultimate union with the Light.

attributions.surface_quote: Ever his destiny shall lead him onward until he is One with the Light.

canonical_statement: Human history is characterized by cyclical rises and falls of civilizations and consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: Man has risen and man has fallen as ever new waves of consciousness flow.

canonical_statement: The soul is not tethered to a single physical location or planetary existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The Soul of man moves ever onward, bound not by any one star.

canonical_statement: Humanity possesses the potential to evolve into divine beings through the acquisition of knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: As I to thee am a God by my knowledge, so ye, too shall be Gods.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of reality is a singular, unified source that encompasses both the beginning and the end.

attributions.surface_quote: the Source of all wisdom, the place of beginning, that is yet One with the end.

canonical_statement: At the culmination of cosmic cycles, all individual existence merges into a state of absolute oneness.

attributions.surface_quote: in a time that is yet unborn, all shall be One and One shall be All.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is capable of transcending the current space-time continuum to exist in other dimensions.

attributions.surface_quote: shall move even from out of this space-time into another beyond the stars.

canonical_statement: The soul is inherently deathless and capable of persisting across multiple ages.

attributions.surface_quote: The time will come when ye, too, shall be deathless.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is capable of merging with a singular, universal substrate of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Blend thou thy Soul in the Great Essence.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of consciousness is identification with a universal light source.

attributions.surface_quote: One, with the Great Light let thy consciousness be.

canonical_statement: The realization of universal oneness grants mastery over life and death.

attributions.surface_quote: all shall be opened when ye shall find the oneness of all

canonical_statement: Death is a transformative state of light and fire rather than an end.

attributions.surface_quote: a death that is life and is fire and is Light

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness contains the source of all life and death within the heart.

attributions.surface_quote: Look in thy heart where the knowledge is bound

canonical_statement: The Earth is a living entity with a spirit that sustains all embodied life.

attributions.surface_quote: Earth is living in body as thou art alive

canonical_statement: Physical existence is maintained by the balanced polarity of the individual form.

attributions.surface_quote: thy form is dual, balanced in polarity

canonical_statement: Death is the result of a loss of equilibrium between the poles of the physical form.

attributions.surface_quote: Death approaches, it is only because thy balance is shaken

canonical_statement: An individual who achieves perfect internal balance can synchronize with the Earth's balance to transcend death.

attributions.surface_quote: When thou hast learned to hold thine own balance, then shalt thou draw on the balance of Earth

canonical_statement: The physical body's vitality is maintained by the specific orientation and movement of consciousness within the energetic centers.

attributions.surface_quote: Hold thou in balance once in each seven, and thy balance will retain its strength.

canonical_statement: The soul is a distinct entity capable of separating from the physical form to merge with a higher source of light.

attributions.surface_quote: Forth from thy form will thy silver spark fly, upward and onward to the Sun.

canonical_statement: Reincarnation is a process governed by the conscious will of the soul, allowing for the transition between lives.

attributions.surface_quote: Thus pass the great Souls, changing at will from life unto life.

canonical_statement: The mastery of time and the retention of past-life memories are achieved by focusing consciousness in the brain-seat during the transition of death.

attributions.surface_quote: Hold thou thy flame here in thy brain-seat until the fingers of Death grasp.

canonical_statement: The past, present, and future are unified when the consciousness is properly anchored during the transition of death.

attributions.surface_quote: Then shalt the past be as one with the present.

canonical_statement: The physical Earth serves as a transitional threshold or portal to higher dimensional states of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Know ye this Earth is but a portal

canonical_statement: The human soul must undergo purification from darkness to transition into higher states of light.

attributions.surface_quote: the soul must be cleansed of its darkness, ere ye may enter the portals of Light.

canonical_statement: The human constitution consists of the Ba (eternal essence) and the Ka (the shadow or life-force), with the Ba requiring the Ka to be incarnate.

attributions.surface_quote: Ba is the essence, living forever. Ka is the Shadow that man knows as life.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of the Divine is a beginningless and endless circle, encompassing all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: learn of the circle beginningless and endless, the form of He who is One

canonical_statement: Creation originates from a primeval equilibrium consisting of three unities: one God, one Truth, and one point of freedom.

attributions.surface_quote: In the primeval, dwell three unities... one God, one Truth, one point of freedom.

canonical_statement: The Divine nature is characterized by the triad of infinite power, infinite wisdom, and infinite love.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the qualities of God... Infinite power, Infinite Wisdom, Infinite Love.

canonical_statement: The fundamental creative forces of the universe are Divine Love, Divine Wisdom, and Divine Power acting in synthesis.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the powers creating all things: Divine Love, Wisdom, and Power.

canonical_statement: Existence is structured into three primary states: the absolute state of God, the state of chaos/death, and the state of life/awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the circles of existence: Light, Chaos, and Awareness.

canonical_statement: The individual soul progresses through three evolutionary stages: Man, Liberty, and Light.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the paths of the Soul: Man, Liberty, Light.

canonical_statement: The First Cause is an eternal, singular, and sustaining intelligence that governs all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: There is one, even the First, who hath no beginning, who hath no end.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness contains a reflection of the divine Light, enabling potential union with the First Cause.

attributions.surface_quote: I beheld that Light, high above all darkness, reflected in my own being.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progress is hindered by ignorance, lack of divine attachment, and attachment to negative forces.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the hindrances: lack of knowledge; non-attachment to god; attachment to evil.

canonical_statement: The universe requires regulatory entities to maintain equilibrium against entropic chaos.

attributions.surface_quote: Lords of Arulu... with their Infinite balance could stand in the way of the inpouring chaos.

canonical_statement: Individual souls possess the capacity to transcend darkness and attain a state of luminous existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Saw all the souls who had conquered the darkness. Saw the splendor of Light.

canonical_statement: The soul retains the ability to choose its own path of service and incarnation.

attributions.surface_quote: I stood in the Halls of Amenti and made my choice to the work I would do.

canonical_statement: Esoteric knowledge must be obscured through symbolism to ensure it is accessible only to the prepared.

attributions.surface_quote: Hide them in symbols, so the profane will laugh and renounce.

canonical_statement: Human beings possess an inherent divine essence that allows them to become god-men.

attributions.surface_quote: God-men in Truth as in essence ye be.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is defined by fractal geometry and harmonic resonance.

attributions.surface_quote: Cup of the Holy Grail

canonical_statement: Darkness and light are ontologically identical, differing only in their degree of order.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness and light are both of one nature, different only in seeming.

canonical_statement: The purpose of existence is the transmutation of disorder (darkness) into order (light).

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness transmuted is light of the Light. This, my children, your purpose in being.

canonical_statement: Human existence is structured as a threefold nature: physical, astral, and mental.

attributions.surface_quote: Know ye, ye are threefold in nature, physical, astral and mental in one.

canonical_statement: The astral plane functions as a mediator between the physical and spiritual realms.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the natures of the Astral, mediator is between above and below.

canonical_statement: The mind serves as the carrier of the Divine Will and the arbiter of causality.

attributions.surface_quote: Three are the natures of Mind, carrier it of the Will of the Great One.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is bound to the Earth plane by planetary vibrational waves.

attributions.surface_quote: Encircling each planet, a wave of vibration, binds him to his plane of unfoldment.

canonical_statement: The human soul possesses the inherent capacity to transcend physical and spatial limitations through the exercise of will.

attributions.surface_quote: Bound are ye in your body, but by the power ye may be free.

canonical_statement: The human soul is capable of detaching from the physical body to access non-physical realms.

attributions.surface_quote: Leave thou thy body as I have taught thee.

canonical_statement: Mental focus and purity of intent are necessary prerequisites for navigating metaphysical dimensions.

attributions.surface_quote: Pure must ye be in mind and in purpose.

canonical_statement: The spiritual realm exists in a state of darkness relative to the physical world, yet contains the true light of spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness of Earth, but Light of the Spirit.

canonical_statement: The individual identity can command entry into higher realms by asserting its essential nature as light.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the Light. For me are no barriers.

canonical_statement: Access to hidden dimensions is restricted to those who actively seek and possess the required wisdom.

attributions.surface_quote: Only to those who seek my wisdom.
